title: The null, cut once
direction: Combination of null-stem (B) and slashed-zero (C): B's heavy Space Grotesk MacNull with its emptied final l, and C's backslash-struck zero, joined by one cut angle square to the backslash on every free stem top
rationale: The user chose B's word and C's icon; one blade makes them a single system: the backslash leans 26 degrees from vertical and every free stem top in the word is cut square to it at 26 degrees, so the stems read as sliced by the same blade that strikes the zero. The hollow l gets heavier walls (50 units, counter 40) so it holds as an emptied stem at small sizes.
construction: Symbol: C's outer zero (656x896 on 1024), side walls 150, horizontals 136, backslash blade 136 at 26 deg, counters filleted r22. Small: walls 128/112, blade 120. Word: Space Grotesk 700, cap 600, tracking -20, chisel 26 deg on M, N, N, u, u, l stems; hollow l 140 wide, walls 50, top 46, bottom 46.

pitch.idea: MacNull in a heavy engineered grotesque whose last l is left hollow; the icon is that ll pair on its own, one solid stem and one emptied stem, both cut by the same 26-degree blade: present but emptied, the way a cleaned file still sits in the Trash.
strengths: the icon comes straight from the word, so word and icon are one idea
one 26-degree cut runs through every stem top and both icon stems
reads as 1 and 0 (set and null) to developers
weaknesses: the two bars can read as a pause button or a battery level before they read as ll
the hollow l of the word fills in below about 14 px cap height

readsAs: a rounded capital N in a pill (icon)
MacNull with a glitched or cursor-like last letter (wordmark)
a slashed zero only once told

critique.reason: coherent and calm, but the backslash zero reads as an N first, and the hollow l collapses below 24 px

brand-fit.rationale: calm, exact, developer-native; no cleaner cliches

semantic-relevance.rationale: \0 and the emptied l are apt but both need explaining

distinctiveness.rationale: blade joins wall-to-wall so the icon reads as a rounded N monogram, a crowded territory

memorability.rationale: hollow last l is the memorable hook; icon less so

simplicity.rationale: one path, one idea per part

balance.rationale: centered and steady; blade acute counters feel cramped

craft.rationale: counters pinch to slits at 32 px; hollow l fills in below 24 px

typography.rationale: Space Grotesk 700 is solid but the default dev-startup face; the chisel is the only ownership

color.rationale: Tailwind blue-500 on slate-900: correct, generic, contrast passes

cultural-fit.rationale: null and slashed zero are native to the audience

versatility.rationale: works in one colour and reversed; needs the small variants
